currentWork.title: FINAL.37 active highway IC search
currentWork.releaseStatus: Implementation is validated on PR #172 and awaits production merge/live verification. FINAL.36 remains the current production release until merge.
fieldEvidence: After FINAL.36, real-device use still showed routes that did not use a highway that should be practically available.
Root cause boundary: ORS alternatives can omit a useful motorway route entirely, leaving VENDRIVE nothing to rank.
scope: When highway ON and existing ORS alternatives contain insufficient motorway use, VENDRIVE actively discovers nearby OpenStreetMap highway=motorway_junction nodes through a bounded Overpass request.
VENDRIVE builds at most two plausible entry/exit IC pairs and requests additional ORS driving-hgv routes through those waypoints.
Every extra route preserves the exact registered HGV dimensions/weight/axleload restrictions and ferries avoidance.
Extra IC routes remain candidates only; FINAL.36 time/distance detour bounds and near-fast ranking remain authoritative.
If IC discovery or an extra route fails, navigation returns the normal safe HGV route.
Overpass discovery is cached briefly per warm instance and only runs after normal candidates prove highway use insufficient.
Additional ORS calls are capped at two and count toward the existing per-warm 30 route-call/minute guard.
No car routing or straight-line fallback is introduced.
